home.subtitle: Mobile software engineer. I take React Native apps from written spec to store release — offline-first Firebase sync, REST API integration, tested with Jest. I work with AI coding agents and review every change before it reaches main.

about.title: About
about.description: I'm studying Computer Engineering at TEC in Costa Rica, graduating in 2028. I work in mobile development with React Native and Expo, and I've built two applications for TEC research projects that field technicians use today.
about.bio: I write the spec before I write code, implement it with AI coding agents, and review every diff before it lands. Architecture decisions go into ADRs in the repository, with their context and consequences. I'm looking for a team with code in production and real code review.
about.location: Costa Rica · UTC−6, full overlap with US business hours
about.rol: Mobile development · React Native and Expo

about.craft: Before I wrote code I did photography, and it left me with the habit of looking closely — composition, contrast, what doesn't belong in the frame. It's the same attention I bring to an interface.

projects.title: Projects

descriptions.agrivision: There's no signal in the barn. The app captures herd assessments offline and reconciles them once the network returns, with Last-Write-Wins conflict resolution over Firebase.
descriptions.agroclass: Classifying land use meant cross-checking national technical criteria by hand. Guided 14-category flow, geolocation, background photo upload and PDF report generation.
descriptions.instaladores: An internet installation company had nothing but WhatsApp as a storefront. I built them a site that captures requests.
descriptions.portfolio: This site, rebuilt from an audit: LCP went from 1132 ms to 96 ms after removing the opacity fade on the element that marked it.
